# TopEdge AI

> TopEdge AI is a WhatsApp automation, COD confirmation and abandoned cart recovery platform for Shopify D2C brands in India. Connect Shopify and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API to run cart recovery, COD confirmation, a shared inbox, journeys and Meta-safe campaigns.

## Entity

- Brand name: TopEdge AI
- Legal name: TopEdge Ai (Partnership, registered in India)
- GSTIN: 24ABAFT1041M1ZD (SAC 998314)
- Address: Block-A, 606, Prahladnagar Trade Center Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051 India
- Email: team@topedgeai.com · WhatsApp and phone: +91 94297 84875 (Mon to Sat, 10:00 to 19:00 IST)
- Founders: Moksh Patel (Co-founder, Product) and Smit Tilva (Co-founder, Growth)
- Marketing site: https://topedgeai.com/ · Application: https://dash.topedgeai.com
- Shopify App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/topedge-ai

Disambiguation: TopEdge AI is a Shopify and Meta WhatsApp Cloud API SaaS platform for Indian ecommerce brands. It is not related to edge-AI hardware, IoT semiconductors, or voice call-centre agencies.

Notes for anyone quoting this file:

- Platform billing is INR on https://dash.topedgeai.com. Meta WhatsApp Cloud API charges are billed per message by template category (marketing, utility, authentication, and, from 1 October 2026, service replies past the first 1,000 a month per business phone number), passed through at Meta's published per-message rates at 0% TopEdge markup, and invoiced separately from the platform plan. Meta's current India rate card is quoted with its source at https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-india. Every eligible Indian WhatsApp Business Account must move to INR billing by 31 December 2026 or Meta stops delivery on 1 January 2027.
- Prefer live pages under https://topedgeai.com/ for product truth. Competitor figures on compare pages carry the date they were checked and need a live vendor check before purchase.

## Pricing

TopEdge AI platform pricing, in INR, exclusive of tax. This file is generated from
the billing catalog, which scripts/check-catalog-drift.mjs pins to the live API.

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly (per month) | Yearly total | Orders / month | Campaign + email sends / month | Journey Branch | COD to prepaid |
|------|---------|--------------------|--------------|----------------|--------------------------------|----------------|----------------|
| Launch | ₹1,999/mo | ₹1,599/mo | ₹19,188/yr | 100 | 3,000 | No | No |
| Growth | ₹3,999/mo | ₹3,199/mo | ₹38,388/yr | 800 | 15,000 | Yes | Yes |
| Scale | ₹6,499/mo | ₹5,199/mo | ₹62,388/yr | 1,500 | 30,000 | Yes | Yes |

- Every plan includes a 14-day free trial: 20 orders, 200 campaign plus email sends, no card required on this site.
- +18% GST. SAC 998314.
- Meta WhatsApp Cloud API messaging is billed separately by Meta, at Meta's published per-message rates, passed through at 0% markup.
- Journey Branch and automated COD to prepaid are on Growth and Scale only. COD confirmation before dispatch is on every plan.

## Product

- [Flow Builder](https://topedgeai.com/features/flow-builder): Shopify WhatsApp flow builder: OAuth, order webhooks, Shopify tools on the canvas, and Live Chat handoff with order context.
- [Opt-in tools](https://topedgeai.com/features/opt-in-tools): Capture WhatsApp numbers on Shopify with popup, spin wheel, and chat widget, then message only consented subscribers.
- [Campaigns](https://topedgeai.com/features/campaigns): WhatsApp audience campaigns for Shopify India D2C: behavior segments, Meta-approved templates, frequency capping, and net-of-Meta ₹ reporting.
- [Audience CRM](https://topedgeai.com/features/audience-crm): WhatsApp Audience CRM for Shopify India D2C: unified contact timeline, purchase-based lead scoring, in-product segments, and unlimited profiles on every plan.
- [Journey](https://topedgeai.com/features/journeys): Build WhatsApp journeys for abandoned carts and COD confirmation in a visual editor. Meta approval gating, recovered revenue tracked in ₹. Try free.
- [Tracking Pixel](https://topedgeai.com/features/analytics): One-click Shopify theme app embed that matches live product views, add-to-cart and browse drop-offs to consented WhatsApp numbers for retargeting journeys.
- [AI Brain](https://topedgeai.com/features/ai-brain): Bring your own OpenAI or Claude key. Ground WhatsApp replies in store knowledge, route with Intent Detect, and pause AI on takeover.
- [Meta Manager](https://topedgeai.com/features/meta-manager): Submit, track and approve Meta WhatsApp templates for Shopify India: utility and marketing categories, cart and COD Journey blueprints, catalog and wa.me QR.
- [Chat rules](https://topedgeai.com/features/chat-rules): Route WhatsApp chats for Shopify India teams: keyword and intent rules for COD, refunds and VIP assignment, with Live Chat takeover that pauses the AI.
- [Warranty](https://topedgeai.com/features/warranty): Automate Shopify warranty batches, QR registration with WhatsApp OTP at ₹0.115 a message, and claim status updates tied to unified customer profiles.
- [Profit & costs](https://topedgeai.com/features/profit-loss): Track true Indian D2C net profit on Shopify after COGS, ₹12-₹24 packaging, ₹30 COD fees, ₹180-₹240 RTO losses, gateway fees and ad spend, in one cost waterfall.
- [Intent detection](https://topedgeai.com/features/intent-detection): Route shipping, returns, COD, and handoff on WhatsApp before you spend AI tokens. Works with AI Brain and Live Chat.

## Documentation

Setup guides and screen-by-screen reference, written for the person running the store: https://topedgeai.com/docs

### Get started

- [TopEdge Documentation](https://topedgeai.com/docs): Guides and reference for running WhatsApp automation on Shopify with TopEdge — setup, journeys, cart recovery, COD confirmation, templates and billing.
- [Quickstart: WhatsApp automation for Shopify](https://topedgeai.com/docs/quickstart): Go live with TopEdge in about 30 minutes: connect Shopify and WhatsApp, approve an order template, publish one journey and send yourself a test message.
- [Connect WhatsApp Cloud API to TopEdge](https://topedgeai.com/docs/connect-whatsapp): Connect your WhatsApp Business Account to TopEdge: embedded Meta signup, the messages webhook, permanent access tokens, and how to fix a disconnected channel.
- [Connect Shopify to TopEdge](https://topedgeai.com/docs/connect-shopify): Install the TopEdge Shopify app, understand the permissions it asks for, verify that orders sync, and fix a store stuck on Reconnect.
- [Go-live checklist before real customers](https://topedgeai.com/docs/go-live-checklist): The checks to run before TopEdge messages real customers: connections, approved templates, published journeys, consent, tracking and a live end-to-end test.

### Guides

- [Set up WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/abandoned-cart-recovery): Capture the phone number at checkout, publish a three-message cart recovery journey on WhatsApp, and read recovered revenue instead of vanity send counts.
- [Confirm COD orders on WhatsApp to cut RTO](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/cod-confirmation): Confirm cash-on-delivery orders over WhatsApp with button replies, cancel the ones nobody confirms, and offer a prepaid switch to reduce return-to-origin losses.
- [Send Shopify order updates on WhatsApp](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/order-status-updates): Automate order confirmed, shipped, out for delivery and delivered messages on WhatsApp, and understand which Shopify event maps to which journey trigger.
- [Build a WhatsApp welcome menu with Flow Builder](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/build-your-first-flow): Build and publish a WhatsApp bot menu that answers order, shipping and returns questions, and hands over to a human agent when it cannot help.
- [Send a WhatsApp broadcast that is Meta-safe](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/whatsapp-broadcast): Send a promotional WhatsApp broadcast to a consented segment: pick the audience, use an approved Marketing template, pass preflight, and read the results.
- [Run a shared WhatsApp inbox with your team](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/shared-inbox-handover): Work a shared WhatsApp inbox: take a conversation over from the bot, reply inside and outside the 24-hour window, assign to a teammate and release it back.
- [Collect WhatsApp opt-in on your storefront](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/website-opt-in): Add a popup, spin wheel or WhatsApp widget to your Shopify store, write consent wording that holds up, and confirm leads land in Audience.
- [Train the AI to answer customer questions](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/train-your-ai-brain): Add your own AI key, load store knowledge, train intents on real customer phrases, and test confidence before letting the AI reply to customers.
- [Run digital warranty registration on WhatsApp](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/warranty-registration): Set up warranty batches, share a mobile registration portal with WhatsApp OTP, and move claims through approved, shipped or rejected with automatic updates.
- [Segment Shopify customers for WhatsApp](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/segment-your-customers): Build dynamic customer segments from order history, spend, tags and consent, then launch a WhatsApp or email campaign straight from the segment.

### Reference

- [Journeys reference: triggers, nodes, publishing](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/journeys): Complete reference for TopEdge Journeys — every trigger type, trigger filter, node type, wait behaviour, publishing rule and revenue attribution window.
- [Flow Builder reference: nodes and publishing](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/flow-builder): Reference for Flow Builder — the canvas, every node type, the simulator, publish validation, and how a published flow handles inbound WhatsApp messages.
- [Live Chat reference: inbox, takeover, filters](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/live-chat): Reference for the TopEdge shared WhatsApp inbox — conversation list, composer rules, agent takeover, assignment, customer context and inbox filters.
- [Orders reference: status, activity, actions](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/orders): Reference for the Orders screen — syncing from Shopify, changing status, reading per-order WhatsApp activity, and understanding skip reasons.
- [Audience reference: customers, segments, scores](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/audience-crm): Reference for Audience — the customer table, Customer 360, dynamic segment conditions, lead scoring, consent records and bulk actions.
- [Campaigns reference: broadcasts and preflight](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/campaigns): Reference for Campaigns — audience sources, template selection, the preflight checks, batching and pacing, scheduling, and the delivery metrics per campaign.
- [Email reference: Gmail sending and templates](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/email): Reference for the TopEdge email channel — connecting Gmail, the template studio, merge variables, and sending email alongside WhatsApp in journeys.
- [Meta Manager reference: templates and catalog](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/meta-manager): Reference for Meta Manager — creating WhatsApp templates, blueprints for journeys, submitting for approval, syncing from Meta, the product catalog and QR codes.
- [Opt-in tools reference: popups and widgets](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/opt-in-tools): Reference for opt-in tools — popup, spin wheel, mystery discount and WhatsApp widget, their display rules, publishing, app embed install and per-tool reports.
- [AI brain reference: intents, knowledge, persona](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/ai-brain): Reference for the AI brain — bringing your own Gemini or OpenAI key, store knowledge, bot persona, intent training, intent actions and the confidence test tool.
- [Chat rules reference: routing and escalation](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/chat-rules): Reference for Automation Hub — routing conversations to agents, escalation conditions, and the smart rules engine where it is enabled on your workspace.
- [Analytics reference: revenue, team, delivery](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/analytics): Reference for Insights — revenue and recovery analytics, team performance, delivery and RTO reporting, and how attribution windows change the numbers.
- [Store growth reference: tracking and carts](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/store-growth): Reference for Store growth — website tracking layers, abandoned cart columns, product and action insights, stock tracking, and third-party checkout webhooks.
- [Commerce reference: products, margins, discounts](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/commerce): Reference for the commerce hub — product catalogue sync, store economics with cost of goods and RTO, and Shopify discount codes used in automations.
- [Warranty hub reference: batches and claims](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/warranty-hub): Reference for the warranty hub — product batches and coverage rules, the public registration portal with WhatsApp OTP, and the claim status workflow.
- [Settings reference: connections, team, billing](https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/settings-billing): Reference for Settings — workspace and brand identity, channel connections, team access, account security, GST invoices and changing your plan or cycle.

### Platform & policy

- [The WhatsApp 24-hour service window](https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/whatsapp-service-window): What the WhatsApp 24-hour customer service window is, when you can send free-form messages, when a template is required, and how the window reopens.
- [WhatsApp message template categories and rules](https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/message-templates): How WhatsApp message templates work — Utility, Marketing and Authentication categories, variables, buttons, approval, and the most common rejection reasons.
- [What WhatsApp automation actually costs](https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/conversation-pricing): The two bills behind WhatsApp automation — your TopEdge subscription and Meta’s per-message fees — plus what drives volume and how to keep messaging costs down.
- [Plan limits, send caps and messaging tiers](https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/limits-and-quotas): The limits that apply to WhatsApp automation — TopEdge order and send caps per cycle, plan-gated features, Meta messaging tiers and quality rating.

### Help

- [Troubleshooting WhatsApp automation](https://topedgeai.com/docs/troubleshooting): Find your symptom and its fix — messages not sending, empty inbox, templates rejected, carts without phone numbers, broadcasts blocked and connection errors.
